benefits.opusDisclosureMessage: $10 off for 24 Months: New customers only. Offer not available to DIRECTV or U-verse TV customers switching to DIRECTV via Internet. Requires purchase and maintaining ENTERTAINMENT and above. Customer must activate service and account must remain in good standing to receive all credits. You will lose this offer and/or any portion of this offer if you cancel your service. Returning customers who disconnected service within previous 12 months are not eligible for this offer. LIMIT ONE OFFER PER DIRECTV CONNECT VIA INTERNET ACCOUNT. May not be combined with certain offers. Offer may be changed or discontinued at any time.
